comment: Ranges for the installed 2.0.0: Clock 30 to 900 BPM (default 120), Probability 0 to 100% (default 100), Divide by 1 to 64 (default 1), Neg. Range -10V to 0V (default -5V), Pos. Range 0V to 10V (default 5V). Two quirks a person should settle. First, the probability roll is rand() modulo 101 and passes when the setting is strictly greater than the roll, so 100% still misses about one trigger in 101. Second, TRG Out is given the same channel count as POLY OUT, and each row that samples writes 10V onto its own channel of TRG Out without anything setting it back to 0V; only channel 1, which follows the common trigger, is rewritten every sample. The entry describes channel 1 only.
